title: Oozy Spanish Beef Shin Stew
description: A tangy and molten Spanish dish featuring beef shin, this crowd-pleaser is made by emulsifying the sauce and serving it in a banana leaf vessel, making it a unique and delicious kosher-friendly option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef shin chunks and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine and beef broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Use two forks to shred the beef into bite-sized pieces.
Stir the sauce to emulsify it, then taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
To serve, place a portion of the beef and sauce onto a banana leaf, and fold the leaf to enclose.
